title: Ephesians Chapter 6 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Ephesians chapter 6 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Ephesians Chapter 6 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Ephesians Chapter 6.

questions.question: In Ephesians 6, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Children, obey your parents in the Lord
And, ye fathers, provoke not your children
questions.correctAnswer: Children, obey your parents in the Lord
questions.explanation: This statement appears first in Ephesians 6:1, making it the first command in the chapter.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 6:1 instruct children to do?
options: Obey their parents in the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Obey their parents in the Lord
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:1 clearly states that children should obey their parents in the Lord.

questions.question: What is the first commandment with promise according to Ephesians 6:2?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:2 specifies that 'Honour thy father and mother' is the first commandment with promise.

questions.question: What is the promise associated with honouring one's parents in Ephesians 6:3?
options: It may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth
questions.correctAnswer: It may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:3 states that the promise of honouring parents is that it may be well with you and you will live long.

questions.question: What should fathers not do according to Ephesians 6:4?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:4 instructs fathers not to provoke their children to wrath.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 6:5, servants are to be obedient to whom?
options: Their masters according to the flesh
questions.correctAnswer: Their masters according to the flesh
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:5 specifically states that servants should be obedient to their earthly masters.

questions.question: What attitude should servants have when being obedient, according to Ephesians 6:5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:5 mentions that servants should obey with fear and trembling.

questions.question: In Ephesians 6:6, servants are to serve not with what?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:6 states that servants should not serve with eyeservice, which refers to doing things only to please others.

questions.question: What should servants be doing according to Ephesians 6:6?
options: The will of God from the heart
questions.correctAnswer: The will of God from the heart
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:6 encourages servants to do the will of God from the heart.

questions.question: What kind of service should be done according to Ephesians 6:7?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:7 instructs that service should be done with good will.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 6:8, who shall receive good for good deeds?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:8 states that whatsoever good thing any man does, he shall receive good from the Lord.

questions.question: In Ephesians 6:8, what will happen to the good deeds done by any man?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:8 affirms that good deeds will be rewarded by the Lord.

questions.question: In Ephesians 6:4, fathers are encouraged to bring up their children in what?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:4 states that fathers should bring up their children in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

questions.question: Ephesians 6 states that children should only obey their fathers.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:1 states that children should obey their parents, not just their fathers.

questions.question: Ephesians 6:5 instructs servants to be disobedient to their masters.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:5 specifically instructs servants to be obedient to their masters.

medium.title: Ephesians Chapter 6 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Ephesians Chapter 6 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What should masters do according to Ephesians 6:9?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:9 instructs masters to do the same things unto their servants and to forbear threatening, showing a call for kindness and fairness.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 6:3 promise will happen if someone honors their father and mother?
options: They will live long on the earth
questions.correctAnswer: They will live long on the earth
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:3 states that honoring one's father and mother is linked to a promise of long life on the earth.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 6:10 encourage brethren to do?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:10 encourages believers to find their strength in the Lord and in His might.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 6:11 instruct believers to put on?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:11 instructs believers to put on the whole armor of God to stand against the devil's schemes.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 6:12, against whom do we wrestle?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:12 explains that our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against spiritual forces including principalities and powers.

questions.question: What is promised in Ephesians 6:13 for those who take on the whole armor of God?
options: They will withstand in the evil day
They will be praised by men
questions.correctAnswer: They will withstand in the evil day
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:13 states that taking on the whole armor of God will enable believers to withstand in the evil day.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 6:14 say about the loins?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:14 instructs believers to have their loins girt about with truth as part of the armor of God.

questions.question: What preparation is mentioned in Ephesians 6:15?
options: Preparation of the gospel of peace
questions.correctAnswer: Preparation of the gospel of peace
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:15 emphasizes the importance of being shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 6:16 say about the shield of faith?
options: It is a symbol of hope
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:16 states that the shield of faith is crucial as it helps to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 6:5 encourage servants to do?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:5 teaches servants to be obedient to their masters with sincerity and respect.

questions.question: What is the instruction given to fathers in Ephesians 6:4?
options: Provoke not your children to wrath
questions.correctAnswer: Provoke not your children to wrath
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:4 instructs fathers to not provoke their children to anger but to nurture them in the Lord.

questions.question: What is the relationship between doing good and receiving from the Lord as mentioned in Ephesians 6:8?
options: Good deeds only matter to men
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:8 states that whatever good anyone does, they will receive the same from the Lord, indicating a system of divine reward.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 6:10 suggests that strength comes from oneself.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:10 emphasizes being strong in the Lord and in His power, not in one's own strength.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 6:12 indicates that our struggle is against physical beings.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:12 clarifies that we wrestle not against flesh and blood but against spiritual forces.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 6:9 encourages masters to threaten their servants.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:9 instructs masters to forbear threatening, promoting fairness and kindness instead.

hard.title: Ephesians Chapter 6 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Ephesians Chapter 6.

questions.question: What is the 'sword of the Spirit' referred to in Ephesians 6:17?
questions.explanation: The 'sword of the Spirit' is defined as 'the word of God' in Ephesians 6:17, emphasizing its role in spiritual warfare.

questions.question: What does Paul urge believers to do in Ephesians 6:18?
questions.explanation: In Ephesians 6:18, Paul instructs believers to pray always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit.

questions.question: In Ephesians 6:19, what does Paul ask for regarding his preaching?
questions.explanation: Paul specifically asks for utterance to be given unto him so that he may open his mouth boldly in Ephesians 6:19.

questions.question: What does Paul identify himself as in Ephesians 6:20?
questions.explanation: In Ephesians 6:20, Paul identifies himself as an ambassador in bonds, highlighting his imprisonment while spreading the gospel.

questions.question: Who does Paul send to the Ephesians in Ephesians 6:21?
questions.explanation: Paul mentions Tychicus in Ephesians 6:21, stating he shall make known all things regarding Paul's affairs.

questions.question: Which of the following is mentioned in Ephesians 6:23 as being given to the brethren?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:23 states, 'Peace be to the brethren,' as a blessing from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'πνεῦμα' (pneuma) in Ephesians 6:17 mean?
questions.explanation: 'πνεῦμα' (pneuma) translates to 'Spirit,' referring to the Holy Spirit, which empowers believers.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Ephesians 6:17 with the phrase 'helmet of salvation'?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'helmet of salvation' in Ephesians 6:17 is a metaphor, illustrating the protective nature of salvation in spiritual warfare.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of spiritual warfare in Ephesians 6:12?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 10:4 connects to Ephesians 6:12 by discussing the weapons of our warfare being spiritual, not carnal.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage fulfills the call to prayer found in Ephesians 6:18?
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:17, which says 'Pray without ceasing,' fulfills the call to constant prayer in Ephesians 6:18.

questions.question: What comes before the instruction in Ephesians 6:17?
options: The preparation of the gospel of peace
The loins girt about with truth
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:16, which discusses the shield of faith, directly precedes the instruction to take the helmet of salvation in Ephesians 6:17.

questions.question: What comes after the exhortation to 'pray always' in Ephesians 6:18?
options: For me, that utterance may be given unto me
And take the helmet of salvation
questions.correctAnswer: For me, that utterance may be given unto me
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:19 follows the exhortation to pray always in Ephesians 6:18, as Paul asks for boldness in preaching.

questions.question: The concept of 'ambassador' in Ephesians 6:20 aligns with which Old Testament role?
questions.explanation: The role of an ambassador in Ephesians 6:20 aligns with the prophetic role of delivering God's message, similar to Old Testament prophets.

questions.question: The statement 'Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity' in Ephesians 6:24 is a declaration of what?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:24 indeed declares grace for those who love Jesus Christ in sincerity, affirming the importance of genuine faith.

questions.question: The phrase 'love with faith' in Ephesians 6:23 implies that love can exist without faith.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:23 connects love and faith, indicating that true love is intertwined with faith, and cannot exist separately.

theological.title: Ephesians Chapter 6 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Ephesians Chapter 6 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 6:6 teach about sanctification?
options: Sanctification involves serving God from the heart, not merely external compliance
Sanctification is achieved by strict legalistic obedience to masters
Sanctification is only for the clergy and not for servants
Sanctification is primarily about outward ritual purity
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification involves serving God from the heart, not merely external compliance
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:6 emphasizes serving not with 'eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,' indicating sanctification involves internal transformation rather than mere external compliance.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 6:12 teach about the nature of spiritual conflict?
options: The believer's struggle is against spiritual forces, not against flesh and blood
The believer's struggle is primarily against sinful human nature
The believer's conflict is with earthly governments and rulers
The believer's battle is only internal and psychological
questions.correctAnswer: The believer's struggle is against spiritual forces, not against flesh and blood
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:12 states explicitly that 'we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world,' teaching the doctrine that spiritual conflict is primarily against spiritual wickedness.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 6:8 teach about God's justice and reward?
options: God rewards every good deed impartially, regardless of social status
God rewards only those who are free and have authority
God's reward is based on human merit and effort alone
God rewards only public acts of righteousness
questions.correctAnswer: God rewards every good deed impartially, regardless of social status
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:8 teaches that 'whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free,' affirming God's impartial justice and reward for all good works.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ephesians 6:9 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:9 states 'neither is there respect of persons with him,' highlighting God's attribute of impartiality in dealing with masters and servants alike.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ephesians 6:23 demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:23 offers 'Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,' showing God's attribute as the giver of peace.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 6:10-11 connect to the broader biblical theme of spiritual warfare?
options: It prepares believers to stand firm in spiritual battles by relying on God's power
It teaches that physical weapons are sufficient for spiritual victory
It denies the existence of spiritual enemies
It emphasizes human strength over divine assistance
questions.correctAnswer: It prepares believers to stand firm in spiritual battles by relying on God's power
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:10-11 commands believers to 'be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might,' and to 'put on the whole armour of God,' connecting to the biblical theme of relying on divine power for victory in spiritual warfare.

questions.question: In what way does Ephesians 6:4 anticipate the theme of Christ as the perfect Father in Scripture?
options: By instructing fathers not to provoke children but to nurture them in the Lord, reflecting God's fatherly care
By commanding harsh discipline as a sign of authority
By emphasizing children’s absolute obedience without question
By promoting societal hierarchies over familial love
questions.correctAnswer: By instructing fathers not to provoke children but to nurture them in the Lord, reflecting God's fatherly care
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:4 instructs fathers to 'bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord,' which prefigures the biblical portrayal of God as a nurturing and loving Father, setting a model for earthly fathers.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Ephesians 6:14 and Ephesians 6:17 teach about Christian righteousness and salvation?
options: The believer must be clothed with truth and righteousness and protected by salvation and the Word of God
Righteousness is irrelevant to salvation which is by works
Salvation is only about external rituals without the need for truth
Truth and salvation are unrelated concepts
questions.correctAnswer: The believer must be clothed with truth and righteousness and protected by salvation and the Word of God
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:14 speaks of 'loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness,' while 6:17 mentions 'helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,' together teaching that Christian righteousness and salvation are essential spiritual protections.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Ephesians 6:5 and Ephesians 6:9 teach about Christian ethics in social hierarchy?
options: Both servants and masters must act with reverence to Christ and fairness towards one another
Only servants are commanded to obey, while masters have no responsibilities
Masters are to rule harshly without consideration
Servants should only obey out of fear of punishment
questions.correctAnswer: Both servants and masters must act with reverence to Christ and fairness towards one another
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:5 commands servants to obey 'as unto Christ,' and 6:9 instructs masters to forbear threatening, knowing their Master is in heaven, teaching mutual Christian ethical responsibility within social roles.

questions.question: What doctrine about prayer and perseverance is taught by Ephesians 6:18 and Ephesians 6:20?
options: Persistent prayer in the Spirit is necessary for bold proclamation of the gospel
Prayer is optional for effective ministry
Prayer should be private and not involve others
Boldness in ministry comes from self-confidence, not prayer
questions.correctAnswer: Persistent prayer in the Spirit is necessary for bold proclamation of the gospel
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:18 commands praying always with perseverance, and 6:20 requests boldness in speech, linking persistent Spirit-led prayer to effective gospel proclamation.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Ephesians 6:5-8 promotes uncritical submission to unjust masters. What does the passage actually teach?
options: Believers serve masters sincerely as serving Christ, implying spiritual motivation rather than blind submission
Believers should only obey masters if they are just
The passage encourages rebellion against masters
Service is only for public approval, not spiritual obedience
questions.correctAnswer: Believers serve masters sincerely as serving Christ, implying spiritual motivation rather than blind submission
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:5-8 teaches servants to obey 'with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ,' emphasizing serving from the heart as service to God rather than uncritical submission to human masters.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 6:16 teach about the role of faith in spiritual warfare?
options: Faith acts as a shield to quench the fiery darts of the wicked
Faith is unnecessary in spiritual conflict
Faith is only for salvation, not protection
Faith is a passive belief without active defense
questions.correctAnswer: Faith acts as a shield to quench the fiery darts of the wicked
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:16 describes the 'shield of faith' which 'ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked,' teaching that faith is an active and essential defense in spiritual battle.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ephesians 6:19 demonstrate in Paul's request for boldness in proclaiming the gospel?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:19 shows Paul asking for 'utterance' to speak boldly the gospel mystery, demonstrating God's attribute of grace as the enabling power for ministry.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ephesians 6:1-3 and Ephesians 6:23-24 teach about Christian life?
options: Obedience and honoring parents is rooted in God’s promise of peace, love, faith, and grace
Obedience to parents is purely cultural with no spiritual significance
Peace and grace are unrelated to family relationships
Faith and love come only through works without promise
questions.correctAnswer: Obedience and honoring parents is rooted in God’s promise of peace, love, faith, and grace
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:1-3 connects honoring parents with a promise of well-being, while 6:23-24 blesses peace, love with faith, and grace from God, showing the integration of family obedience with divine blessing in Christian life.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 6:7-8 deepen the understanding of serving others as service to God?
options: Service is done with goodwill as to the Lord, knowing God rewards all good deeds
Service is merely a social obligation without spiritual value
Only free people can truly serve God
Service is only valid if publicly recognized
questions.correctAnswer: Service is done with goodwill as to the Lord, knowing God rewards all good deeds
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:7-8 teaches that service is to be done 'with good will... as to the Lord' and that 'whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord,' emphasizing spiritual motivation and divine reward.
